gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.
'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: ___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
